newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends down vs dlr, firmer vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends down vs dlr, firmer vs basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed slightly lower against the dollar on Monday, tracking the dollar/mark, dealers said.
The forint was unchanged compared with the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) currency basket, closing some 10 pips below the NBH's resistance level.
The forint closed at 161.12/17 to one dollar, compared with its opening of 161.10.
Turnover was very low, as most market players prepared for the yearend closing of their books, dealers said.
"There were hardly any deals," said Kereskedelmi Bank's Zsabolcs Brezina.
Heavy year-end turnover continued on the currency futures market of the Budapest Commodity Exchange. The turnover climbed to a record 16.8 billion forints.
Most deals were struck in Ecu, dollar and sterling. The dollar and the Ecu weakened for the March maturity, while the sterling closed firmer for September.
